cases.trigger: Warm object lookup with many bundles/places
cases.expectation: Bounded indexed lookup; measure reads, latency and memory; no census

cases.trigger: Cached miss followed by another writer publishing the object
cases.expectation: Generation-aware invalidation; new verified copy becomes discoverable

cases.trigger: Watched external cache disconnects or overflows event queue
cases.expectation: Mark affected scope stale/unknown; bounded recovery, no false absence

cases.trigger: Two worktrees ingest identical bytes concurrently
cases.expectation: One immutable publication per place; both get accurate observations

cases.trigger: Crash between physical publication and catalog update
cases.expectation: Recover completed bytes without false completion or orphan data loss

cases.trigger: Reader acquires object while eviction is planned
cases.expectation: Fresh active-use protection fences removal at object/place scope

cases.trigger: Plain pointer, malformed OID, wrong size or unsupported extension
cases.expectation: Correct exact identity or explicit rejection; no arbitrary path lookup

cases.trigger: LFS agent upload/download retries and parallel requests
cases.expectation: Protocol-correct idempotent results; bounded concurrency and truthful completion

cases.trigger: LFS local store plus hydrated worktree plus Tig cache
cases.expectation: Measure all allocated copies; do not claim logical dedup means zero physical cost

cases.trigger: Generic Git-only repo replaces an LFS file and merges
cases.expectation: Tig derives old/new object claims without Art, preserves other users and plans placement

cases.trigger: Enroll a Git/LFS repo without Art
cases.expectation: Plan from exact pointers and local policy; no full hydration/census

cases.trigger: Same object requested by two unrelated repos
cases.expectation: Share permitted bytes; retain independent claims and access scope

cases.trigger: Catalog lost but durable job/claim records remain
cases.expectation: Rebuild conservatively; no removal before protection recovery

cases.trigger: Both catalog and an authoritative protection journal are missing
cases.expectation: Block removal; do not invent empty protection from branch heads

cases.trigger: Producer completes before staging or committing
cases.expectation: Durable ingest/job protection covers the gap; new bytes are not garbage

cases.trigger: LFS clean runs outside Tig and creates a new local LFS object
cases.expectation: Reconcile explicit source/index and admit protection; no assumed Tig write event

cases.trigger: Transfer-agent request supplies only OID and size
cases.expectation: Resolve exact object, not an invented branch or lifecycle status

cases.trigger: Merge conflicts leave three index stages
cases.expectation: Protect known alternatives; unresolved state is not a merged snapshot

cases.trigger: Partial staging, detached HEAD and dirty worktree coexist
cases.expectation: Separate views and protections; never overwrite user edits

cases.trigger: Branch rename/delete/rebase and remote prune occur
cases.expectation: Authorized source transition; preserve other claims and unknown remote scope

cases.trigger: Attributes change which tracked paths represent LFS content
cases.expectation: Invalidate affected extraction context; no stale inventory shrink

cases.trigger: Git merge succeeds while archive is offline
cases.expectation: Desired checkpoint advances; placement visibly pending; retain needed local bytes

cases.trigger: Thin and hydrated worktrees consume the same object
cases.expectation: Same byte identity; distinct materialization cost and mutation safety

cases.trigger: Demotion needs headroom on a full destination
cases.expectation: Budget peak and batch safely or block; no unsafe source deletion

cases.trigger: Hook is disabled and a new ref arrives
cases.expectation: Explicit catch-up converges from exact refs without a daemon or duplicate claims

cases.trigger: Publication succeeds but its acknowledgement is lost
steps: Retry the same operation after restart
cases.expectation: Recognize the prior object publication; do not publish twice or shrink protection

cases.trigger: Power loss occurs after destination bytes are written but before verified publication
cases.expectation: Revalidate destination bytes before exposing completion; keep source protected

cases.trigger: A protection journal ends with a torn record
cases.expectation: Mark the uncertain suffix incomplete; recover authoritative state before removal

cases.trigger: Only an older protection backup can be restored
steps: Replay known later operations and compare source generations
cases.expectation: Do not assume absent later job records expired; block destructive work until scope is recovered

cases.trigger: Two workers restore the same coordinator identity from a backup
cases.expectation: Fence stale authority; avoid a pair of independent destructive writers

cases.trigger: Wall clock moves backwards while a job lease approaches expiry
steps: Observe old and new clock values during renewal
cases.expectation: Anomalous time cannot prove that protection ended; follow declared clock policy

cases.trigger: A reader cannot renew while coordinator connectivity is lost
steps: Attempt planned removal of its object
cases.expectation: Require an effective reader fence/recovery contract; timeout alone is not permission

cases.trigger: Claim handoff crashes between old and new checkpoint records
cases.expectation: Protect the union until durable transition outcome is known

cases.trigger: An archive drive is detached and a different drive reuses its mount path
cases.expectation: Reject the stale place identity; the replacement is not the verified archive

cases.trigger: A release intent exists but its provider result was never recorded
steps: Restart and retry the release transaction
cases.expectation: Inspect exact object/place state; report absent versus present without inventing a complete retained copy

cases.trigger: A reader arrives after a plan marks an object surplus
steps: Acquire a read while removal tries to start
cases.expectation: Serialize the conflicting scope so a granted read remains protected

cases.trigger: An object path is removed and reused between validation and deletion
cases.expectation: Fence exact object identity and provider generation, not the reused path

cases.trigger: Two publishers reserve the same remaining free space
cases.expectation: Admission accounts for both reservations; do not oversubscribe capacity

cases.trigger: A branch is deleted while its renderer is still using old objects
steps: Retire branch claims and continue the job
cases.expectation: The independent admitted job claim continues to protect its inputs

cases.trigger: Two projects share bytes but require incompatible placement/privacy rules
cases.expectation: Share only permitted copies and report unsatisfied constraints; no last-writer rule

cases.trigger: A user loses removal authority after producing a dry run
steps: Attempt apply under the old token
cases.expectation: Recheck current authority; refuse the stale destructive action

cases.trigger: A claim generation counter would overflow
cases.expectation: Reject explicitly rather than wrap and admit stale work

cases.trigger: A remote provider cannot enforce the required stale-writer fence
cases.expectation: Leave the operation unsupported/blocked until an adequate backend protocol exists

cases.trigger: An idempotency key is reused for a different object payload
cases.expectation: Reject conflicting operation identity; never replay a success for different bytes

cases.trigger: A shelved draft expires while another branch adopts one of its objects
cases.expectation: Preserve adoption/active claims; expire only the owning draft obligation

cases.trigger: A clone uses pointer-only checkout and requests one file
cases.expectation: Acquire only the explicitly requested object under budget; no branch-wide hydration

cases.trigger: Git LFS local storage is configured outside the common Git directory
cases.expectation: Account for the actual configured local-store identity; avoid an invented duplicate default

cases.trigger: A remote reports authorization failure rather than missing content
cases.expectation: Expose denied access distinctly; do not rewrite it as absence or try unadmitted sources

cases.trigger: An upload process exits after a partial destination write
steps: Receive a nominal success indication and inspect transfer completion
cases.expectation: Require exact destination-contract verification; partial bytes do not satisfy upload

cases.trigger: A pointer uses an unsupported extension/transform
cases.expectation: Block the affected mapping; do not equate transformed bytes with a plain OID

cases.trigger: A Git LFS prune would touch storage shared with another enrolled worktree
cases.expectation: Require coordinated all-consumer protection; Tig claims do not make an external pruner safe automatically

cases.trigger: A change to attributes changes pointer interpretation for many unchanged files
cases.expectation: Invalidate affected interpretation context and rescan only admitted scope with coverage

cases.trigger: Git garbage collection expires reflogs that once named a retained release
cases.expectation: Preserve admitted release objects independently of reflog lifetime

cases.trigger: A ref is force-pushed while an LFS upload is still in flight
steps: Complete upload and derive branch placement
cases.expectation: Keep verified ingest useful but bind adoption to the actual new ref, not transfer timing

cases.trigger: A repository supplies a custom transfer executable or credential-bearing URL
cases.expectation: Require trusted local admission; never execute or export it merely because it is committed

cases.trigger: A sparse file reports a large logical size but occupies few blocks
cases.expectation: Distinguish logical transfer size from measured allocation; do not invent savings

cases.trigger: Two paths are hard links to the same underlying data
steps: Count copies and edit one path
cases.expectation: Do not count independent custody; prevent mutation of shared immutable content

cases.trigger: Compacting a shared pack requires more temporary space than is free
cases.expectation: Keep pack pinned and report blocked capacity or a separately budgeted compaction

cases.trigger: An encrypted object changes storage keys without changing plaintext
steps: Rotate representation while retaining old readers
cases.expectation: Preserve plaintext identity and key/representation access until protected readers finish

cases.trigger: A cross-volume copy is interrupted before source retirement
steps: Restart transfer with a partially allocated destination
cases.expectation: Resume/revalidate within budget; source remains until destination obligations are satisfied

cases.trigger: Case folding or Unicode normalization makes two logical paths collide
steps: Materialize a bundle on a less expressive filesystem
cases.expectation: Reject or use a declared reversible mapping; no silent overwrite

cases.trigger: An object becomes corrupt after a prior integrity observation
steps: Request it or consider using it as retained custody
cases.expectation: Invalidate the stale observation, reacquire if permitted, and preserve other good copies

cases.trigger: Another application consumes disk space after Tig reserves capacity
cases.expectation: Handle provider full-disk safely; reservations are admission controls, not guarantees about external writers

cases.trigger: A producer exceeds its output estimate halfway through writing
cases.expectation: Bound or pause the operation; renegotiate explicitly rather than fill the entire cache

cases.trigger: An unregistered hot object is classified for archive-only retention
steps: Admit an explicit archive claim and reconcile
cases.expectation: Verify archive requirements before releasing the hot copy; no last-copy deletion

cases.trigger: A bundle manifest is small but expands into excessive descendants
steps: Resolve it within declared read budgets
cases.expectation: Return explicit incomplete scope when limits are exhausted; no unbounded traversal

cases.trigger: Imported manifests contain a cycle or inconsistent child identity
cases.expectation: Reject malformed graph/identity before materialization; do not trust root naming alone

cases.trigger: A moving bundle reference advances while a reader opens a file
steps: Resolve and acquire the requested snapshot
cases.expectation: Pin one exact snapshot; never mix old metadata with new byte selection

cases.trigger: A partial place profile leaves two eligible destinations with no tie-break policy
cases.expectation: Keep the assignment unresolved or use an explicitly pinned deterministic rule

cases.trigger: One digest is advertised with conflicting sizes in two inventories
cases.expectation: Reject the inconsistency instead of choosing whichever report arrived last

cases.trigger: Torrent metadata would expose confidential file names to unadmitted peers
cases.expectation: Use an admitted opaque/encrypted mapping and privacy review; private discovery flags alone are insufficient

cases.trigger: All seeds disappear halfway through a download
cases.expectation: Keep partial state, report unavailable sources, and do not count an independent complete replica

cases.trigger: A file root is known but supporting piece data are unavailable
cases.expectation: Identity knowledge does not imply byte availability; acquisition stays pending

cases.trigger: A minor edit causes a compressed output to share almost no byte chunks
steps: Estimate version storage using content similarity
cases.expectation: Use measured byte-level reuse rather than visual similarity or an assumed delta ratio

cases.trigger: A backup client without Art submits overlapping immutable bundles
cases.expectation: Apply the same object/place rules and independent claim ownership without media assumptions

cases.trigger: A producer writes a new large file into an admitted Tig working directory
steps: Seal the completed write and bind the logical path
cases.expectation: Protect partial/new ingest; publish exact immutable bytes only after completion and validation

cases.trigger: A new file has one local copy while backup replication is pending
steps: Keep editing before the first commit
cases.expectation: Admit bounded draft protection and expose pending redundancy rather than claim a complete backup

cases.trigger: The local Git commit contains the new LFS pointer
cases.expectation: Keep exact bytes available locally; commit success does not fabricate remote custody

cases.trigger: Git push succeeds for a branch containing only small pointer changes
cases.expectation: Schedule configured replica obligations; pointer push does not prove payload upload or independent backup

cases.trigger: A pull request requires two independent retained copies
steps: Evaluate the exact candidate and custody evidence
cases.expectation: Gate only the configured transition; count real failure domains, not aliases or directories

cases.trigger: A branch merges to main with already replicated working bytes
cases.expectation: Reuse existing copies and retain other jobs; no new physical directory or second content merge

cases.trigger: A current version becomes previous under a two-copy retention policy
cases.expectation: Verify required history/archive copies across independent failure domains before hot release

cases.trigger: A user checks out an older retained version in a new branch
cases.expectation: Acquire missing hot copies under budget without discarding newer retained versions

cases.trigger: Another worktree starts on the same project and consumes existing bytes
cases.expectation: Share permitted cached objects, preserve job ownership and account for editable materializations

cases.trigger: A repository is moved locally while its Tig namespace remains enrolled
steps: Rebind trusted local root and reconcile source identity
cases.expectation: Preserve logical paths/owned claims without treating the new filesystem path as a new backup
